svg.aria-label: Two rooms. In Pricing, Alice asks Belle to post notes to Sales. Belle asks which version, then asks before posting to a wider audience, and Alice approves. In Ops, Bob asks Belle to restart the api pods. A rule says only David approves actions there, so Bob's click is turned down. David approves, and Belle restarts the pods.
